zh-CN: 队列新增可选的“卡顿规避”，超大文件夹可抽取 200 个代表文件参与 MD5 和文件级相似度计算。
代表文件同时覆盖大文件和完整目录中的不同位置，避免只取开头文件。
极小文件可先跳过再补足代表样本；完整清单、归档内容和源文件变化校验不受影响。
队列相似报告遵循任务入队时保存的卡顿规避设置。
en-US: Queue settings add optional stall avoidance, allowing very large folders to sample 200 representative files for MD5 and file-level similarity.
Representative files cover both large content and different positions across the full directory instead of only taking the first files.
Tiny files can be excluded before filling the sample; the complete manifest, archived content, and source-change checks remain unaffected.
Queue similarity reports follow the stall-avoidance settings captured when each task is added.
